question: Select the option with the correct use of article(s).

options.text: She kept lot of rules in her life, due to which she is flourishing today.
She kept an lot of rules in her life, due to which she is flourishing today.
She kept a lot of rules in her life, due to which she is flourishing today.
She kept the lot of rules in her life, due to which she is flourishing today.

solution:
The correct answer is 'C'' i.e. "She kept a lot of rules in her life, due to which she is flourishing today." which uses the article correctly..
